title: Golden CI: use java -cp instead of mvn exec:java for spectator spawns
description:
Each spectator JVM is launched via `mvn -q exec:java` in Mage.Client.Observer (golden_helpers.py _start_spectator). Maven adds significant startup overhead on top of JVM startup: parsing POMs, resolving plugins, building the classpath, etc.

Pre-computing the classpath once at session scope (e.g., `mvn dependency:build-classpath`) and then using `java -cp <classpath> <MainClass>` for each spectator spawn could save 5-8s per test.

With 10 tests, that's 50-80s total. This optimization also applies to the two-replay tests that spawn their own subprocess bridge/potato clients.

The session-scoped bridge and potato already use mvn exec:java (paid once), so this primarily benefits the per-test spectator spawns and the subprocess clients in two-replay tests.

Expected savings: ~50-80s (~1 min).
